items.how: [^ethics] lead and *Widening*: 'on a finite listing, one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting that counts each listed thing above zero ranks it higher (Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive)', plus 'the same holds of any class of orders that contains those weightings' orders and only orders already ranking each widening higher (Weighting.widens_iff_every_of_class)', 'of a valuer whose order is not additive and does not already rank each widening higher, these results say nothing'. 'what every way of counting each thing as worth something agrees on' is gone from the notes. [^good-evil]'s 'all weightings positive on every item' became 'all additive weightings that count every listed item above zero'. Chinese: 凡给每个所列之物一个大于零的权重、再把权重相加的计法，一致排得更高的，恰好就是扩大. FOR-REN's plain-words form: 'every way of adding up worth that counts each thing above zero' (凡给每样东西一个大于零的权重、再把权重相加的计法).

items.item: H2 no premise beside the life's concern
items.how: [^ethics]: 'So ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern: where the condition holds, that concern already does it'; the ranking theorem 'its proof using the condition only at the life's own standpoint' (checked in the docstring); C's history: 'C is no longer introduced as a second foundation of the ethics; the name stays for the requirement particular theorems take', the frame of 10 October to 9 November kept as where the map was wrong; the body's 'second reading' and 'better' read as 'add no premise beside a life's own concern'. 'no second premise' is gone from the notes in both languages (按扩大来排序，并不在生命自身的关切之外另加前提).

'argued, not shown' and 已论证，未表明 are gone from both notes. [^ethics]: 'that order is, in the proofs, a hypothesis. That a life forms such an order is not shown: what the models show of persisting is a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed', with what 07 §4.9 gives: where an ending choice is realized as an overdraw, choices consistent with keeping above ending and, where only ending was at stake on the occasions met, with self-concern there; where degrees of keeping are at stake persisting does not force it (a witness); a course never met can be ranked below one it widens; the course a persisting line actually takes is never a listed path (Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted). Lead: 'not shown, and how such orders form is open'. [^own]'s lead 'Argued, not shown' became 'A reading, in three senses; in the proofs, hypotheses; that a life forms an order over courses is not shown, and how such an order forms is open'; the presupposition's holding 'a further question' (07 §4.7, which says so); 'The first does not give the other two' narrowed to 'the first does not give the third', since the stone shows only that going on gives no order. Links to 07 #what-persisting-shows and #crux.

[^axiom] and [^ethics]: 'Where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: nothing in it requires their losses to count', with Downstream.one_way and Clearing.center_not_derived named as witnesses. Chinese: 依存若只沿一个方向，对自身延续的关切未必把依存于它的那些也算进来：其中没有什么要求把它们的损失计入. The lake sentence is not in the opening's notes.

[^ethics]: 'C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens (Comparison)'; [^alignment]: 'C (Comparison: the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens)'; [^good-evil]: 'states what it takes of the order, self-concern or C's requirement'. Chinese: C 指这样一项要求…; 要求一个次序把…; 或 C 这项要求. The opening's notes give C no Chinese name, so 以广为愈/广者居上 does not arise in these files.

[^axiom]: 'dated occurrences among them' and 'so "where relations close" is said of formations, read without time' gone; now 'These relations are read across all steps: one formation affects another where, at some step, it exchanges with a condition the other depends on at some step, the two steps in either order. On an acyclic relation the condition holds only where every standpoint has the same center («续无外则同一中心»).' Nothing is said of what holds in time, and J3's names are not cited. [^present]: 'affecting read across all steps'. Chinese: 跨越所有的步来读；两步孰先孰后不论；该条件只在每一个立场都有同一个中心时成立.

[^axiom] lead 'read as each center's reach along being affected'; the reading 'that what has significance from a standpoint is what lies within its center's reach along a relation, its closure under that relation'; 续无外 'along that relation, nothing lies outside each center's reach' (for 'nothing lying outside what each center continues with'); [^ethics]'s reading likewise. Chinese: 沿所选关系，从每个中心都能到达一切; 若把从一个立场看有意义者，读作位于其中心沿某个关系所能到达的范围之内者.

[^ethics] and [^axiom]: 'between two courses whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end'; 'the ranking is shown for courses whose admissions end'. Chinese: 因而二者的容纳终会止息 / 从某一步起都不再容纳任何东西 (终有尽头 gone).

[^ethics]: 'Mutual dependence gives the condition held de se along being affected and along affecting (Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent, ...), and the ranking takes the condition held de se along any relation on the web: the two compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite.' [^axiom] adds Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent (along affecting) beside Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted, linked to 07 §4.9. 'not stated as one theorem' gone in both languages (二者可以直接合成，只是尚无一条定理陈述这一合成).

[^ethics] keeps 'The ethics emerges from continuation, not the other way round' and follows it with '"Emerges" says where it starts, not that it is derived: what is shown is conditional, on self-concern and the condition as hypotheses and on a finite listing; what is offered is counting the losses of those whose loss never returns to oneself; how such orders form is open.' Chinese mirrors (“生出”说的是它从哪里开始，不是说它被推导出来…).

Now: 'a life goes on through what sustains it, and what is not sustained ceases, a paraphrase of the author's words of 8 November, which keep "want" in quotation marks: 'if it doesn't "want" to creates more future, continuation, it simply "cease to exist"'' (verbatim from sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-08-within-becoming-no-should.md, message 1). Chinese gives the quote with 大意［AI 读法］, as [^good-evil] does.

(a1) says widening and, where relations close, that a life holding its own continuation as an order already ranks the wider course above, though not only such courses; (a2), astra's, states the offer and ranks nothing, if you would rather the body hold to your 8 November 'it doesn't need to be ranking/comparison'. (c1) drops the line and its sides; (e1) says the step at its reach; (d1a)–(d3a) keep your voice and put the models' conditions in the sentences, where astra's (d1b)–(d3b) say them in the models' terms (and (d3b) changes your conviction from 'any system' to 'many kinds'). Nothing is applied.

The re-said notes, mainly [^ethics], [^axiom] and [^own], in both languages: that a life forms an order holding its own continuation is now 'not shown' (persisting, in the models, filters what was chosen and forms no order), not 'argued'; widening is what every additive weighting counting each listed thing above zero ranks higher; ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern; C is a requirement on orders, 'no longer introduced as a second foundation of the ethics'; where relations run one way, concern 'need not count' those who depend on one; after 'The ethics emerges from continuation', what is shown, offered and open.
